dn4:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi yena campā tadavasari.
dn4:1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
dn4:1.4: tena kho pana samayena soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo campaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā māgadhena seniyena bimbisārena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
dn4:2.2: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅgesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi campaṃ anuppatto campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre
dn4:2.3: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
dn4:2.4: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
dn4:2.5: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti
dn4:2.6: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
dn4:2.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
dn4:2.8: athakho campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā campāya nikkhamitvā saṅghāsaṅghīgaṇībhūtā yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamanti.
dn4:3.1: tena kho pana samayena soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo uparipāsāde divāseyyaṃ upagato hoti.
dn4:3.2: addasā kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo campeyyake brāhmaṇagahapatike campāya nikkhamitvā saṅghāsaṅghīgaṇībhūte yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamante
dn4:3.4: kiṃ nu kho bho khatte campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā campāya nikkhamitvā saṅghāsaṅghīgaṇībhūtā yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamantīti.
dn4:3.5: atthi kho bho samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅgesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi campaṃ anuppatto campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre

dn4:3.12: evaṃ bhoti kho so khattā soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā campeyyake brāhmaṇagahapatike etadavoca

dn4:4.1: tena kho pana samayena nānāverajjakānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pañcamattāni brāhmaṇasatāni campāyaṃ paṭivasanti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
dn4:4.3: soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatīti.

dn4:5.1: mā bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkami

dn4:5.3: sace bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissati bhoto soṇadaṇḍassa yaso hāyissati samaṇassa gotamassa yaso abhivaḍḍhissati

dn4:5.5: samaṇo tveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
dn4:5.6: bhavaṃ hi soṇadaṇḍo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena
dn4:5.7: yampi bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena iminā caṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
dn4:5.8: samaṇo tveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
dn4:5.9: bhavaṃ hi soṇadaṇḍo aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo …pe…
dn4:5.10: bhavaṃ hi soṇadaṇḍo ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍuketubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo bhavaṃ
dn4:5.11: hi soṇadaṇḍo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇi brahmavacchasi akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya bhavaṃ
dn4:5.12: hi soṇadaṇḍo sīlavā vuḍḍhasīlī vuḍḍhasīlena samannāgato bhavaṃ
dn4:5.13: hi soṇadaṇḍo kalyāṇavāco kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā bhavaṃ
dn4:5.14: hi soṇadaṇḍo bahūnaṃ ācariyapācariyo tīṇi māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti bahukā kho pana nānādisā nānājanapadā māṇavakā āgacchanti bhoto soṇadaṇḍassa santike mantatthikā mante adhiyitukāmā
dn4:5.15: bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto
dn4:5.16: samaṇo gotamo taruṇo ceva taruṇapabbajito ca
dn4:5.17: bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito
dn4:5.18: bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito
dn4:5.19: bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo campaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā māgadhena seniyena bimbisārena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ
dn4:5.20: yampi bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo campaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā māgadhena seniyena bimbisārena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ
dn4:5.21: iminā caṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
dn4:5.22: samaṇo tveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
dn4:6.1: evaṃ vutte soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca
dn4:6.2: tenahi bho mamapi suṇātha yathā mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
dn4:6.3: na tveva arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
dn4:6.4: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena
dn4:6.5: yampi bho samaṇo gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena iminā caṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
dn4:6.6: athakho mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
dn4:6.7: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo mahantaṃ ñātisaṅghaṃ ohāya pabbajito …pe…
dn4:6.8: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajito bhūmigatañca vehāsaṭṭhañca
dn4:6.9: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo daharo va samāno susū kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
dn4:6.10: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo akāmakānaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
dn4:6.11: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇi brahmavacchasi akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya
dn4:6.12: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sīlavā ariyasīlī kusalasīlī kusalasīlena samannāgato
dn4:6.13: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo kalyāṇavāco kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā
dn4:6.14: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo bahūnaṃ ācariyapācariyo
dn4:6.15: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo khīṇakāmarāgo vigatacāpallo
dn4:6.16: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo kammavādī kiriyavādī apāpapurekkhāro brahmaññāya pajāya
dn4:6.17: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo uccākulā pabbajito abhinnakhattiyakulā
dn4:6.18: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo aḍḍhā kulā pabbajito mahaddhanā mahābhogā
dn4:6.19: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ tiroraṭṭhā tirojanapadā saṃpucchituṃ āgacchanti
dn4:6.20: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ anekāni devatāsahassāni pāṇehi saraṇaṅgatāni
dn4:6.21: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
dn4:6.22: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
dn4:6.23: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato
dn4:6.24: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo ehisāgatavādī sakhilo sammodako abbhākuṭiko uttānamukho pubbabhāsī
dn4:6.25: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo catunnaṃ parisānaṃ sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito samaṇaṃ
dn4:6.26: khalu bho gotamaṃ bahū devā ca manussā ca abhippasannā
dn4:6.27: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo yasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā paṭivasati na tasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā amanussā manusse viheṭhenti
dn4:6.28: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo saṅghīgaṇīgaṇācariyo puthutitthakarānaṃ aggamakkhāyati yathā kho pana bho etesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ yathā vā tathā vā yaso samudāgacchati na hevaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa yaso samudāgato
dn4:6.29: athakho anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya samaṇassa gotamassa yaso samudāgato
dn4:6.30: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṅgato
dn4:6.31: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ rājā pasenadikosalo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṅgato
dn4:6.32: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṅgato
dn4:6.33: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito
dn4:6.34: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo rañño pasenadikosalassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito

dn4:6.39: yampi bho samaṇo gotamo campaṃ anuppatto campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre atithismākaṃ samaṇo gotamo

dn4:6.41: caṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ

dn4:6.43: ettake kho ahaṃ bhoto gotamassa vaṇṇe parayāpuṇāmi no ca kho so bhavaṃ gotamo ettakavaṇṇo

dn4:6.46: yathā kho bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇassa gotamassa vaṇṇe bhāsati ito cepi so bhavaṃ gotamo yojanasate viharati alameva saddhena kulaputtena dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ api puṭosenāti.
dn4:6.47: tenahi bho sabbe va mayaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissāmāti.
dn4:7.1: athakho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkami.
dn4:8.1: athakho soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa tirovanasaṇḍagatassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
dn4:8.2: ahañceva kho pana samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyaṃ
dn4:8.3: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo gotamo evaṃ vadeyya
dn4:8.4: na kho esa brāhmaṇa pañho evaṃ pucchitabbo evaṃ nāmesa brāhmaṇa pañho pucchitabboti tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya
dn4:8.5: bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abyatto nāsakkhi samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ yoniso pañhaṃ pucchitunti
dn4:8.6: yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya yasopi tassa hāyetha
dn4:8.7: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ
dn4:8.9: mañceva pana samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puccheyya tassa cāhaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ na ārādheyyaṃ
dn4:8.10: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo gotamo evaṃ vadeyya

dn4:23.2: evaṃ bhoti kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
dn4:23.4: idha brāhmaṇa tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho …pe… (yathā sāmaññaphale evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ) …pe…
dn4:23.5: evaṃ kho pana brāhmaṇa bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti.
dn4:24.1: evaṃ vutte soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
dn4:24.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
dn4:24.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
dn4:24.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
dn4:24.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgataṃ
dn4:24.6: adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
dn4:24.8: athakho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
dn4:24.9: athakho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi
dn4:25.1: athakho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn4:25.2: athakho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
dn4:26.1: athakho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn4:26.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
dn4:26.3: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama parisagato samāno āsanā vuṭṭhahitvā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ tena maṃ sā parisā paribhaveyya
dn4:26.4: yaṃ kho pana sā parisā paribhaveyya yasopi tassa hāyetha
dn4:26.5: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ
dn4:26.7: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama parisagato samāno añjaliṃ paggaṇheyyaṃ āsanā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccuṭṭhānaṃ dhāretu
dn4:26.8: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama parisagato samāno veṭṭhanaṃ omuñceyyaṃ sirasā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo abhivādanaṃ dhāretu
dn4:26.9: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama yānagato samāno yānā paccorohitvā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ tena maṃ sā parisā paribhaveyya
dn4:26.10: yaṃ kho pana sā parisā paribhaveyya yasopi tassa hāyetha yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ
dn4:26.12: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama yānagato samāno patodalaṭṭhiṃ abbhunnameyyaṃ yānā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccorohanaṃ dhāretu
dn4:26.13: ahañceva kho pana bho gotama yānagato samāno chattaṃ apanāmeyyaṃ sirasā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo abhivādanaṃ dhāretūti.
dn4:27.1: athakho bhagavā soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.
